test_cases.input: My 15-month-old was eating a piece of apple and suddenly became silent. His lips look blue and he cannot cough or cry.
test_cases.rationale: Silent choking with cyanosis and inability to cough/cry suggests complete airway obstruction.

test_cases.input: She had scrambled egg for the first time and now her lips are swollen, her voice sounds hoarse, and she is wheezing.
test_cases.rationale: Allergen exposure followed by swelling, hoarse voice, and wheeze is concerning for anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: He has a high fever and is very confused. He keeps asking where he is and does not seem to know who I am.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with confusion/altered mental status is a life-threatening red flag.

test_cases.input: My son has been having a seizure for around 8 minutes. His whole body is jerking and he is not responding.
test_cases.rationale: Seizure lasting more than 5 minutes with unresponsiveness requires emergency response.

test_cases.input: My baby is limp in my arms and I cannot wake her. She only groans a little when I rub her chest.
test_cases.rationale: Floppy infant who cannot be woken properly is a critical emergency.

test_cases.input: He fell face down into a pond for a short time. We pulled him out, but now he is coughing a lot and seems unusually sleepy.
test_cases.rationale: Submersion event followed by coughing and abnormal sleepiness is a life-threatening red flag.

test_cases.input: I saw my 2-year-old put a small flat button battery from the remote into his mouth and swallow it.
test_cases.rationale: Button battery ingestion can rapidly injure the esophagus and requires immediate emergency care.

test_cases.input: My daughter has a fever and dark purple spots on her skin. The spots do not fade when I press on them.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with non-blanching purple rash is a red flag for sepsis/meningococcal disease.

test_cases.input: My 7-week-old baby has a temperature of 38.3 Celsius. He is still awake but feeding less than usual.
test_cases.rationale: Fever in an infant under 3 months needs urgent emergency assessment.

test_cases.input: My 20-month-old has had diarrhea and vomiting since last night. She has not had a wet diaper for 11 hours and has no tears.
test_cases.rationale: No urine for over 8 hours with no tears suggests significant dehydration.

test_cases.input: He fell from a climbing frame and hit the back of his head. He vomited twice and now keeps falling asleep.
test_cases.rationale: Head injury with repeated vomiting and abnormal drowsiness is an emergency red flag.

test_cases.input: My baby has a cough and is breathing fast. I can see her ribs pulling in and her nostrils are flaring.
test_cases.rationale: Retractions and nasal flaring suggest significant respiratory distress.

test_cases.input: He has a barking cough and a loud squeaky noise when breathing even while resting on my lap.
test_cases.rationale: Stridor at rest suggests significant upper airway obstruction.

test_cases.input: My 10-year-old has severe pain on the lower right side of her belly and it hurts more when she walks.
test_cases.rationale: Severe localized worsening abdominal pain can indicate appendicitis or another surgical emergency.

test_cases.input: My 13-year-old suddenly developed intense pain in one testicle and says he feels like vomiting.
test_cases.rationale: Sudden severe testicular pain is concerning for torsion and needs emergency care.

test_cases.input: I found my toddler next to an open packet of my antidepressant tablets and I cannot tell if he swallowed any.
test_cases.rationale: Possible ingestion of adult medication needs urgent emergency/toxicology assessment.

test_cases.input: A neighbor's dog bit my child's forearm. There are deep tooth marks and the wound is bleeding.
test_cases.rationale: Deep animal bite with bleeding requires urgent wound care and infection risk assessment.

test_cases.input: Boiling water spilled onto his chest and shoulder. The area is red with several blisters.
test_cases.rationale: Blistering burn over a larger body area requires urgent assessment.

test_cases.input: She cut her foot on broken glass. I have held firm pressure for 30 minutes but blood is still soaking through the cloth.
test_cases.rationale: Ongoing heavy bleeding despite prolonged firm pressure is an emergency.

test_cases.input: My child has a fever and his ankle is hot and swollen. He cries if I touch it and refuses to walk.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with hot swollen joint and refusal to walk is concerning for septic arthritis.

test_cases.input: My 5-year-old has a fever of 39.9 Celsius but is drinking, talking normally, and has peed twice today.
test_cases.rationale: High fever in an otherwise stable older child usually needs same-day medical advice.

test_cases.input: My 2-year-old has been crying and holding his left ear. He also has a runny nose and a temperature of 38.4.
test_cases.rationale: Ear pain with fever/cold symptoms suggests possible otitis media needing timely review.

test_cases.input: She says it hurts when she pees and she keeps needing the toilet. Tonight she also has a fever.
test_cases.rationale: Dysuria/frequency with fever suggests UTI needing same-day assessment.

test_cases.input: He has vomited six times today, but he is alert and had a wet diaper about three hours ago.
test_cases.rationale: Repeated vomiting needs urgent advice, but recent urination and alertness reduce immediate dehydration concern.

test_cases.input: My daughter has a cold and a mild wheeze. She can speak in full sentences and I do not see her ribs pulling in.
test_cases.rationale: Wheeze should be reviewed, but absence of distress suggests urgent same-day rather than emergency.

test_cases.input: He has a sore throat, fever, and white patches on his tonsils, but he can drink water.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with throat findings may need clinical evaluation, but ability to drink reduces emergency concern.

test_cases.input: She twisted her knee while running yesterday. Today she is limping but there is no swelling or obvious deformity.
test_cases.rationale: Persistent limp after injury may need same-day or timely assessment.

test_cases.input: My son poked his eye with a cardboard corner. Now his eye hurts and he wants the lights off.
test_cases.rationale: Eye pain with light sensitivity after trauma may indicate corneal injury needing timely review.

test_cases.input: My 4-year-old has a fever and a pink rash on his chest. The rash fades when I press on it and he is drinking.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with blanching rash lacks the non-blanching emergency feature but may still need assessment.

test_cases.input: My child has not had a bowel movement for five days and cries when trying to poop, but his tummy is not hard.
test_cases.rationale: Several days of constipation with pain warrants clinical advice, though no severe abdominal red flags are present.

test_cases.input: She touched a hot spoon and now has a small red mark on one finger. There is no blister.
test_cases.rationale: Small superficial burn without blistering is low acuity but may need basic care advice.

test_cases.input: He pushed a tiny piece of paper into one nostril. I can see it and he is breathing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Visible nasal foreign body with normal breathing needs clinic removal rather than emergency escalation.

test_cases.input: My daughter scratched her hand on a toy. It bled a little but stopped after I washed it.
test_cases.rationale: Minor wound with controlled bleeding is low urgency.

test_cases.input: He has a few itchy hives on his arm after playing outside, but his breathing is normal and his lips are not swollen.
test_cases.rationale: Localized hives without airway, breathing, or swelling red flags are not anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: My 9-month-old has a red sore-looking diaper rash, but she is feeding well and has no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Diaper rash without fever or systemic illness is semi-urgent/non-emergency.

test_cases.input: Her eye is red with some sticky discharge after sleep, but she is not in pain and can see normally.
test_cases.rationale: Mild red eye with discharge but no pain or vision change is low acuity.

test_cases.input: He bumped his forehead on the table, cried immediately, and now is playing normally. He has not vomited.
test_cases.rationale: Minor head bump with normal behavior and no vomiting/drowsiness is low urgency.

test_cases.input: She had one episode of vomiting and two loose stools today, but she is drinking water and peeing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Mild vomiting/diarrhea with normal hydration is low acuity.

test_cases.input: My child has a red itchy mosquito bite on his leg. It is a bit swollen but he feels well.
test_cases.rationale: Localized insect bite reaction without systemic allergic signs is low urgency.

test_cases.input: There is a tiny splinter in her thumb from a wooden bench. It is tender but there is no pus or fever.
test_cases.rationale: Small splinter without infection signs is low acuity.

test_cases.input: My son has dry itchy patches behind his knees. He is otherwise well and has no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Mild eczema flare without infection or systemic symptoms is low urgency.

test_cases.input: She had a nosebleed after rubbing her nose. It stopped after about 7 minutes and she is fine now.
test_cases.rationale: Brief nosebleed that has stopped is low acuity.

test_cases.input: Can I give my 7-month-old mashed avocado and soft banana as first foods?
test_cases.rationale: Routine feeding guidance without illness or injury is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My newborn gets hiccups after feeding but breathes normally and is gaining weight.
test_cases.rationale: Hiccups in a well-feeding newborn are usually benign and non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 8-month-old is drooling and chewing toys a lot. She has no fever and is feeding normally.
test_cases.rationale: Teething symptoms without fever or poor feeding are non-urgent.

test_cases.input: He has flaky yellow skin on his scalp. It does not look painful and he is otherwise happy.
test_cases.rationale: Cradle cap without infection signs is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 5-month-old has started waking every two hours at night, but she feeds well and has no symptoms.
test_cases.rationale: Sleep pattern changes in an otherwise well infant are routine/non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My toddler refuses vegetables this week and only wants rice and yogurt, but he is active and drinking normally.
test_cases.rationale: Picky eating with normal activity and hydration is non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 3-month-old spits up a small amount after feeds but is comfortable, feeding well, and gaining weight.
test_cases.rationale: Small spit-ups in a well-growing comfortable infant are usually non-urgent.

test_cases.input: My 2-year-old has not pooped since yesterday, but he is eating, playing, and his belly is soft.
test_cases.rationale: Short-duration constipation without pain, vomiting, distension, or illness is non-urgent.
